area: Queen Street corridor, Auckland CBD - first playable area (Han, 2026-10-16: small area, the hottest street)

street.name: Queen Street
street.facts: Major commercial thoroughfare of Auckland CBD, the 'Golden Mile'; 1.7 km, Customs Street (waterfront) to Karangahape Road; established 1840s

hidden_feature: Waihorotiu Stream ('Queen Street River') ran down the Queen Street gully to Waitemata Harbour; now channelled in brick sewers under Queen Street for about 150 years - a factual under-street route for the dungeon layer

terrain.note: Bilinearly resampled from the 286 m/px Auckland zone grid: a smooth valley surface with a true street gradient (see queen_street_profile.json), not street-level detail. Upgrade path: LINZ DEM 8 m / Auckland LiDAR DEM.
terrain.profile_note: queen_street_profile.json is sampled from the smoothed 25 m surface (itself resampled from the 286 m zone grid), so point values near the waterfront read high; the NIWA reference points here are the ground truth for the street gradient: about 0 m at the waterfront rising to the Karangahape ridge.

entry_waterfront.note: North end at Customs Street / Te Komititanga, by Waitemata Station and Commercial Bay - descent landing

hub_aotea_square.note: Mid-street square by the Town Hall and Aotea Centre - natural player hub

south_gate_karangahape.note: South end at the Karangahape Road ridge - exit toward K Road when the world expands
